mentions.name: Vorbim
mentions.description: Free website for Russian speakers in Moldova to learn Romanian, using AI to generate lessons and exercises, AI text-to-speech for pronunciations, and AI-coded cards, backed by open-source word databases. A one-month project currently serving around 100 people daily.
mentions.audience: Russian-speaking people in Moldova who want to learn Romanian
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://vorbim.org/ - free AI generated website for russian speaking folks in Moldova to learn romanian.

AI to generate lessons, excercises
AI text to speech to make pronounciations
AI to code cards
open sources words dbs.

fun 1 month project. gets like 100ppl daily.
